explanation: Proved: no number 2·3^j is a sum of at most 3 distinct elements of ternaryBasis, so it has no restricted order 3. Correct, and combined with hasOrder_ternaryBasis it refutes Kelly's conjecture as erdosproblems.com/338 records. These are private API lemmas supporting the formal disproof of Kelly's conjecture, which erdosproblems.com/338 reports was disproved by Hennecart: there is a basis of order 2 with no restricted order 3. Faithful.
